description: Look up the IANA timezone, current local time, UTC offset, and daylight-saving status for any latitude/longitude. Useful for normalising business hours, scheduling notifications, and enriching geocoded data.

location.description: A single {lat, lng} coordinate to resolve. Use either this or 'locations'.
location.title: Single Location

locations.description: Multiple {lat, lng} coordinates to resolve in one run.
locations.title: Batch Locations

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy. Not normally required; timeapi.io accepts direct datacenter requests.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

title: Google Maps Timezone & Local Time Lookup
